issues.quote: far above $0.17 on $4.4 million of net income
issues.problem: Net income was $4.4 billion, not million. Fiscal 2023 net income was $4.368B, matching the main text.

issues.quote: Please confirm the correct fiscal 2023 EPS, or whether the two years use different share bases
issues.problem: The two years do use different share bases. As originally reported, before the 10-for-1 split in June 2024, fiscal 2023 diluted EPS was $1.74 and fiscal 2022 was $3.85. Adjusted for the split, they are about $0.17 and $0.39. The fact sheet mixes the adjusted $0.17 with the unadjusted $3.85. On either basis, EPS fell about 55%.

data.summary: The main figures match NVIDIA's reported results: revenue of $26.97B vs $26.91B, gross profit of $15.36B vs $17.48B (56.9% margin), operating income of $4.22B vs $10.04B (15.7% margin), R&D of $7.34B vs $5.27B, and net income of $4.37B vs $9.75B (down 55.2%). The EPS note has two errors. It says "million" where it should say "billion." The figures don't reconcile because $0.17 is split-adjusted and $3.85 isn't. Diluted EPS as reported was $1.74 for fiscal 2023 and $3.85 for fiscal 2022; split-adjusted, it was about $0.17 and $0.39.
